description: Rex Parinda Wanagasekara v. Devundara Liyanage Chandrasena de Silva and Others Rex Parinda Wanagasekara v. Devundara Liyanage Chandrasena de Silva and Others View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Rex Parinda Wanagasekara v. Devundara Liyanage Chandrasena de Silva and Others Rex Parinda Wanagasekara v. Devundara Liyanage Chandrasena de Silva and Others View More
keywords: The Plaintiff appealed against the dismissal of his action for failing to comply with a court order directing the pre-payment of costs following his application to amend the plaint during trial. Held - the Plaintiff was bound by the consent given by his Attorney-at-Law to the order for costs and could not avoid its consequences; as the costs were not paid as directed, the trial judge was justified in dismissing the action. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
